title: Huge Codex Update: All My Complaints Addressed
summary: Follow-up review of a big Codex CLI update (collapsed thinking, model switching, image paste, prompts, VS Code extension).

assertions.quote: They really covered just about everything that I was complaining about ... That kind of feels like parity now

verdicts.note: By 2026 the major tools all offer agents, CLIs, cloud runs and review; differences are workflow and pricing more than capability.
